zh: 银行又上调了利率。
en: The banks have put up their {interest rates|rates} again.

zh: 我可以用信用卡付款吗？
en: Can I pay by {credit card}?

zh: 奥克兰的生活成本非常高。
en: The {living costs|living expenses} in Auckland are really high.

zh: 我想开一个银行账户。
en: I'd like to open a {bank account}.

zh: 今天纽币的汇率是多少？
en: What's the {exchange rate} for the New Zealand dollar today?

zh: 我每个月往储蓄账户里存五百块。
en: I put five hundred dollars into my {savings account} every month.

zh: 过去十年里房价翻了一倍。
en: In the last ten years {house prices|property prices|home prices} have doubled.

zh: 他那份兼职只拿最低工资。
en: He's only on the {minimum wage} at his weekend job.

zh: 我得在七月之前提交报税表。
en: I need to file my {tax return} before July.

zh: 我们每月的预算很紧，所以很少出去吃饭。
en: We have a tight {monthly budget}, so we rarely eat out.

zh: 我们每周给孩子们十块零花钱。
en: We give the kids ten dollars a week in {pocket money}.

zh: 按时付账单有助于提高你的信用评分。
en: Paying your bills on time helps your {credit score|credit rating}.

zh: 我的电话费是通过银行自动扣款支付的。
en: My phone bill is paid by {direct debit|automatic payment}.

zh: 如果账单付晚了，会被收滞纳金。
en: If you pay the bill late, you'll be charged a {late fee|late payment fee|late charge}.

zh: 最好存一笔够三个月开销的应急资金。
en: It's smart to have an {emergency fund} that covers three months of expenses.

zh: 扣完税以后，我的实得工资并不多。
en: After tax, my {take-home pay|net pay} isn't that much.

zh: 她还在还学生贷款。
en: She's still paying off her {student loan|student loans}.

zh: 今年我们的房贷还款额涨了不少。
en: Our {mortgage repayments|mortgage payments} have gone up a lot this year.

zh: 这个账户不收银行手续费。
en: There are no {bank fees|bank charges} on this account.

zh: 我工资的百分之四存进了我的退休储蓄。
en: Four percent of my pay goes into my {retirement savings|retirement fund}.

zh: 最近超市的价格上涨让人吃不消。
en: The {price rises|price increases|price hikes} at the supermarket lately have been hard to keep up with.

zh: 我把零钱都放在一个罐子里。
en: I keep all my {loose change|spare change|small change} in a jar.

zh: 买房之前我们咨询了一位理财顾问。
en: We spoke to a {financial adviser|financial advisor|financial planner} before buying a house.

zh: 申请签证需要最近三个月的银行对账单。
en: You need three months of {bank statements} for the visa application.

zh: 这台笔记本电脑我分十二期按月付款。
en: I'm paying for the laptop in twelve {monthly instalments|monthly installments|monthly payments}.

zh: 我把一部分存款放进了定期存款。
en: I've put some of my savings into a {term deposit|fixed deposit|fixed-term deposit}.

zh: 她上大学的时候有一份兼职工作。
en: She had a {part-time job} when she was at uni.

zh: 他晚上送外卖，当作一份副业。
en: He delivers food in the evenings as a {side hustle|side job|side gig}.

zh: 今年我拿到了三百块的退税。
en: I got a three-hundred-dollar {tax refund|tax rebate} this year.

zh: 表格上要填你的年收入。
en: The form asks for your {annual income|yearly income|annual salary}.
